title: Grateful Dead Live at Ungano's Night Club on 1970-02-12
taper: Any/all editing, fades, NR, hiss elimination, phase shifting/"time smear" correction, jitter elimination, and +/-2 dB max. EQ were performed using 100% digital-only processing (24-bit/96 kHz data stream) at Serafin Station Studio B
source: SBD > 2-track RTR @ 15 i.p.s. > PCM > ? > D > SSSB

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear soundboard capture of a solid early ’70 set with standout Black Peter and Saint Stephen, though the performance feels uneven.
ai_review.review: The tape is praised for its crystal‑clear audio quality, making it a joy to listen to even if the show itself isn’t legendary. Reviewers highlight a nice rendition of Black Peter and a good Saint Stephen, while noting that the overall set is just an average early‑1970 performance. The recording’s clarity outweighs the modest musical execution for most listeners.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong praise for audio quality (excellent soundboard) but mixed comments on the show’s performance lead to an overall moderate‑high rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Multiple reviewers call the tape "crystal" and "great sounding," with no reported dropouts or muffling.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Early‑1970 set with a mix of blues/folk material; pacing considered decent but not exceptional, and the crowd reaction on Casey Jones is noted.
